matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 61/100 (above average) against BUF's run defense at 6/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about Sunday: the Patriots have stumbled into perhaps the most lopsided mismatch on this week's board, and we'd be fools not to pound it. New England's rush offense (61/100) is going up against Buffalo's run defense (6/100)—the widest statistical edge anywhere—and in a road game where the offense has been genuinely dreadful (9.7 points per game, dead last in the NFL), leaning on what actually works feels less like strategy and more like survival. The catch, naturally, is everything else. Our pass protection grades a nightmarish 13/100 against Buffalo's above-average pass rush, Greg Van Roten is out with a thigh injury, Drake Maye's shoulder is "fine" (a qualifier that nobody finds comforting), and our pass offense sits at 23/100 against their secondary—so if the Bills load the box to shut down the run, we're asking a hobbled young quarterback protected by dental floss to beat one of the league's best passing attacks. We're underdogs by 6.5 for a reason. But that run matchup? That's real, and it's the only daylight we have.
